summary: Iteration 3 — Image upload (base64) regression for Admin panel (Products/Categories/Banners). BACKEND (17/17 pytest in test_image_upload.py PASSED): all 4 role logins (admin/vendor/delivery/customer) succeed; non-admin tokens get 403 and missing token gets 401 on /admin/* writes; admin POST/PUT /admin/products|/admin/categories|/admin/banners ACCEPT a real data URI 'data:image/jpeg;base64,...' up to 5 MB raw (~6.7 MB base64) WITHOUT 413 Payload Too Large — assertion `r.status_code != 413` held in every case; image is persisted byte-for-byte and returned in GET /api/products, /api/categories, /api/banners (length-equal check + prefix check); PUT swaps the image and GET reflects the change; DELETE round-trips to 404 cleanup. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport, Expo web preview): admin login → routes to /admin → opening Add Product / Add Category / Add Banner modals all render the new ImageUploader with `*-image-gallery`, `*-image-camera`, `*-image-preview` testIDs and NO legacy `pf-image-url`/`cf-image-url`/`bf-image-url` field (all counts == 0, gallery/camera counts == 1). Customer login regression: /home loads cleanly with banners, categories, stores, trending products — 0 console errors during customer flow. Regression of full Phase 1 + Phase 2 suite: 39/41 passing — 2 failures are stale-data count assertions (categories now 6 instead of 5, products 16 instead of 15) due to a manual 'Two wheller' category + 1 extra product seeded by an earlier human UI session that was never cleaned; UNRELATED to image upload changes. 10 console warnings detected from admin modals: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' — should be investigated. Deprecated packages detected: none new (expo-image-picker is current; ImageUploader uses expo-image and MaterialCommunityIcons correctly). Pre-existing shadow* deprecation warnings still present (carried over from prior iterations).

action_items: Fix RN-Web 'Unexpected text node' warning that fires on opening any of the 3 admin modals. Most likely a stray whitespace/template-string between JSX siblings in admin/products.tsx, admin/categories.tsx, admin/banners.tsx, or ImageUploader.tsx. Use React DevTools / search for '{` `}' or stray text outside <Text>.

Clean stale demo data: delete category id 'cat-e6a190' (name 'Two wheller', color '#rrbgd', empty image) and product id 'p-3db21ffb' that were left by a prior manual UI test. After deletion, the Phase 1 count tests (5 categories / 15 products) will pass again — or relax those tests to `>=` if test-created entries are expected to persist.

(Optional hardening) Tighten CategoryIn (BannerIn / ProductIn) schema: validate `color` as a hex-color regex (e.g. ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$), and validate `icon` against an allowed icon set. Currently '#rrbgd' is accepted as a color.
(Optional) Add a server-side max-size guard / clearer 4xx for image fields > 5MB so a 50MB cap doesn't accidentally allow >10MB images that bloat MongoDB docs.
(Carry-over) Migrate shadow* → boxShadow and Image style.resizeMode → resizeMode prop to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1114 lines AND the image fields are unbounded strings (str). For a 50MB ingress cap, recommend adding a Pydantic Field(max_length=14_000_000) on ProductIn.image / CategoryIn.image / BannerIn.image to enforce a hard ceiling and return a clean 422 instead of MongoDB doc bloat.

Storing base64 image bytes directly in product/category/banner documents will pump the document size up close to MongoDB's 16MB BSON limit if a vendor uploads multiple 5MB images. Consider moving to GridFS or static file storage (saving only the URL in the doc) once volumes grow.

GET /api/products / /categories / /banners now serializes the full base64 in every list response — for 15 products with 2MB images each that's 30MB per home-screen call. Consider a lightweight list projection that omits `image` (or returns a thumbnail) and only loads full image on detail.
ImageUploader.tsx uses MediaTypeOptions.Images which is deprecated in expo-image-picker SDK 51+. Replace with `mediaTypes: ['images']` (string-array API) when upgrading SDK.

ImageUploader sets `quality: 0.7` but does not cap dimensions — a 12MP phone photo at 0.7 quality is often 3-4MB which is fine, but consider `allowsMultipleSelection: false` (already default) and an optional resize step (manipulator) before base64 to keep payload predictable.

rca_of_issue: No bug found in image-upload flow. The only new issue surfaced is a low-priority RN-Web warning ('Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>') that fires when any of the 3 admin modals mount — likely a stray whitespace/string between JSX siblings in the modal files or in ImageUploader.tsx. Repro: log in as admin, navigate to /admin/products (or /categories or /banners), tap '+' (testID add-product-btn / add-cat-btn / add-banner-btn). Open browser console and observe the error. Mitigation: search for `>{' '}<` or stray whitespace-only text nodes between JSX children in admin/products.tsx, admin/categories.tsx, admin/banners.tsx, and ImageUploader.tsx; wrap any literal text in <Text>.
